titre: Logements autorisés dans la baie de San Francisco
sous_titre: Nombre de logements autorisés par permis de construire, années 1971, 2018 et 2024

1971.texte: 66,600 units of new housing were issued permits in the Bay Area during 1971, the most approved in a calendar year

2018.texte: 32,500 units of new housing were issued permits in the Bay Area in 2018, the highest in the past three decades

2024.texte: 9,100 units of new housing were issued permits in the Bay Area during 2024, according to data from the Construction Industry Research Board
